basic_info.description: Experience sophistication in San Francisco's sunniest neighborhood with this beautifully remodeled mid-century home, offering 4 bedrooms and 2 baths. Set on an extra-wide street in the vibrant Bayview, this residence combines modern luxury with timeless charm, perfect for a growing family or as a rental property. The main level boasts a sun-drenched south-facing great room with an open-concept design. The chef's kitchen features a spacious island, high-end stainless steel appliances, and a stylish black & white tile backsplash, seamlessly connecting to the dining and living areas with a cozy fireplace and skylight. Two generous bedrooms and a full bath with a skylight complete this level. The primary bedroom opens to a private deck for morning relaxation. Downstairs, two more bedrooms, a full bath, and a kitchenette with a separate entrance offer versatility for guests or a home office. The landscaped backyard, designed by Flora Grubb, includes mature fruit trees and an art studio shed, making it an ideal outdoor retreat. Steps from the T Muni line, easy access to 101 and 280 and walkable to the 3rd St commercial corridor. Come enjoy the best that Bayview has to offer.
